hazards_summary.name: Poke-centre gate and Pokemon
hazards_summary.summary: After GO: monster_wait = rand(1000)+1000. gate_wait starts at 1 so the gate opens (anim GateOpen, gate collision moves to x=1600) on the first Wait tick; while gate_wait == 0 a grounded fighter standing on a nMPMaterialDetect floor makes a Pokemon appear immediately, otherwise one appears when monster_wait hits 0. Pokemon = random of 5 ground monsters (no immediate repeat) at the nMPMapObjKindMonster mapobj; when it is gone: close (x=960), gate_wait 1000, monster_wait rand(1000)+1000.
